name: vscode-frontier-insight
description: Run autonomous research quests inside VSCode, powered by your Copilot subscription via the sanctioned vscode.lm Language Model API. Local Python engine drives an 11-node async LangGraph DAG; this extension hosts the LLM calls.

chatParticipants.name: fi
chatParticipants.description: Run a research quest through the FI engine.

commands.name: new
commands.description: Interactive setup — walks you through topic, outputs, clarify mode, reviewer panel; generates a config.yaml and runs it. Recommended for first-time users.

commands.name: start
commands.description: Start a quest from an existing YAML. Example: @fi /start examples/integrator_bakeoff/config.yaml

commands.name: fleet
commands.description: Start a fleet of quests (space-separated YAML paths). Each YAML's provider.node_models is honored independently.

commands.name: resume
commands.description: Resume a previously-crashed quest from its checkpoint. With no arg, shows a picker. With a quest_id, resumes that quest.

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Generate one more output format (PDF / slides / poster / talk script) for an already-finished quest WITHOUT re-running the research. Pick the quest + format, or pass them: @fi /generate <quest_id> paper_pdf. Mirrors `launch.py --emit` and the web Outputs panel.

commands.name: summarize
commands.description: Walk a folder of mixed content (papers / code / study notes / logs) and produce a structured markdown summary. Input files plus the summary are ingested into Axon. Example: @fi /summarize ./papers literature

commands.name: digest
commands.description: Weekly project-manager digest across your quests: completed, in-progress, themes, diff vs prior digest, suggested next quests. Optional integer arg = window in days (default 7). Example: @fi /digest 14

commands.name: portfolio
commands.description: All-time cross-quest synthesis: topic clusters, near-duplicate detection, meta-paper candidates, coverage gaps, prioritized next-quest suggestions. Lands at outputs/_portfolio/<YYYY-MM-DD>.md.

commands.name: critique
commands.description: Adversarial second-pass review of a completed quest. Pass the quest_id. Reads paper.md + code + prior in-quest review, then asks a (different) model to find what the in-quest reviewer missed. Lands at outputs/<quest_id>/critique.md.

commands.name: proposal
commands.description: Pre-quest planning doc: background, hypothesis, plan, success criteria, risks. Writes a markdown proposal + companion YAML to outputs/_drafts/. Use to scope a quest BEFORE committing compute. Example: @fi /proposal Compare RK4 vs Verlet on the Kepler problem

commands.name: analyze
commands.description: Run a no-simulation quest with pre-staged data. Pass a directory path; every file under it (recursive, symlinks skipped) is copied into the new quest's data/ dir before the engine starts. Then provide a one-sentence analysis topic. Example: @fi /analyze ./my_data Compare ridership trends across regions

commands.name: update
commands.description: Mid-quest re-entry of the interview. Pass the quest_id (or pick from the list). Opens an integrated terminal that runs `python launch.py --update <id>`: pre-fills the editable fields with the quest's current values, computes a diff, soft-invalidates affected LangGraph stages, then resumes.

commands.name: ingest
commands.description: Load PDFs / Markdown / TXT into the Axon corpus as kind=fi_local_paper so future quests retrieve them as prior work. Pass space-separated paths after the command. Opens an integrated terminal running `python launch.py --ingest <paths>`.

commands.name: install-tectonic
commands.description: Install the tectonic LaTeX binary (~70 MB) into tools/ so paper.pdf works without an admin install of MiKTeX. Self-bootstrapping; runs `python launch.py --install-tectonic` in a terminal.

commands.name: drafts
commands.description: List proposal-draft YAMLs in outputs/_drafts/ with a one-click /start hint for each. Mirrors `python launch.py --list-drafts` and the web /interview drafts picker.

commands.name: axon-status
commands.description: Check whether the Axon sidecar (`python -m axon.api`) is reachable on 127.0.0.1:8000. The sidecar keeps the embedding model + vector index hot across quests; CLI/web launches auto-start it, but VSCode users run their own.

frontierInsight.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter for the FI engine. Must have FI's requirements.txt installed.

frontierInsight.repoPath.description: Absolute path to the FrontierInsight repo (containing launch.py). Defaults to the open workspace root.

frontierInsight.outputDir.description: Where finished quests are written (relative to repoPath or absolute).
